diagnosis: The image shows a jammed, amorphous local optimum: roughly 460 contacts are tied within $10^{-9}$, versus only $153\times3-6=453$ effective degrees of freedom, giving average degree about $6.0$, no rattlers, and irregular degrees from 2 to 8. LP polishing is therefore exhausted—the $1.8\times10^{-7}$ gain is merely re-polishing the record basin—and single-point, single-edge, or small random kicks are either blocked by the close second shell or projected back to the same contact graph. The configuration lacks both a flexible low-contact substructure that could undergo a collective rearrangement and any evident symmetric or algebraic organization, such as an orbit structure, that might support a genuinely different topology. Progress consequently requires coordinated multi-contact topology changes or seeds constructed outside this basin, not stronger local optimization.
